statements.status_notes: This is not security vulnerability. The xslt random function provided by libxslt does not offer any security or cryptography guarantees. Applications using libxslt that rely on non-repeatable randomness should be seeding the system PRNG (srand()) themselves, as they would if calling rand() directly.
